subject: Unable to terminate App to deploy a new one

messages.author: 10d6dca99a590445
messages.subject: Unable to terminate App to deploy a new one
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to deploy an update to 

https://gavi.shinyapps.io/NutrientExplorer/

But when I try to deploy or terminate the existing app, I get the following message. I tried the restart using the Admin Website also.

shinyapps::terminateApp("NutrientExplorer")
Terminating application...
Error: /v1/applications/24830/terminate 409 - Unable to terminate application-24830: 1 tasks in progress.

Let me know if there is something I am missing.
